subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose host update execution to gateway-authenticated HTTP callers, and if so should it be a new `/admin/update` endpoint or a narrow Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The request expands host package-update and restart authority from existing Gateway control-plane paths to an HTTP surface, so automation cannot choose the auth scope, ingress assumptions, audit/rate-limit behavior, target-version support, or failure-mode contract safely.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep the version metadata decision in the narrower open issue and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

options.title: Expose via Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` or a narrow wrapper to the default-off Admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit trusted-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, handoff, and target-version proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep the version metadata decision in the narrower open issue and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced Admin HTTP RPC and has adjacent version-resolution history, so they are the best available owner for the security/API direction choice.
